list.title: Approval processes
list.description: Condition-based approval processes for KPI assignment and KPI adjustment requests. Requests that match no process follow the default unit-head chain.
list.deleteDescription: Requests already in approval under these processes continue with the steps set when they were submitted. Later submissions follow another matching process or the default unit-head chain.
list.emptyHint: Every request follows the default unit-head chain. Add a process to set approval steps and approvers by condition.

editor.createHint: Fill in the details, then draw the approval steps below
editor.notFoundHint: The process may have been deleted.
editor.fillRequired: Enter a title and choose an object
editor.fixDiagram_one: The diagram has {{count}} error. Fix it before saving
editor.fixDiagram_other: The diagram has {{count}} errors. Fix them before saving
editor.notChainMode: The organization uses single-level approval. Approval processes only take effect when the approval mode under Workflow settings is "Approval chain".
editor.readOnly: You can only view approval processes. Editing needs the workflow configuration permission (WORKFLOW:MANAGE).
editor.canvasHint: Click (or right-click) a node to add steps, conditions or states; double-click to configure it. Drag the dot on a node's edge to link it by hand.
editor.canvasHintReadOnly: Double-click a step or condition to view its settings.
editor.appliesToNextSubmissions: Changes apply to later submissions only.
editor.leaveDescription: Your edits stay as a draft on this device and come back when you open the process again.
editor.actionShowOnCanvas: Click to show on the diagram
editor.emptyCanvasHint: Click Start to add the first approval step

info.title: Title
info.subObjectsHint: Leave empty to cover every sub-object. A process for specific sub-objects takes precedence over an "All" process.
info.followersHint: Notified when a new request starts under the process and when it is approved or rejected.
info.showInObject: Show the process in the object
info.showInObjectHint: KPI details get a button to view the process diagram, with the path taken and the pending step highlighted.
info.activeHint: When off, the process is kept but not used for new submissions.

canvas.removeIncomingLinks: Remove all links to this step

stepDialog.title: Approval settings
stepDialog.name: Step name
stepDialog.approversHint: With several entries, whoever in the group acts first decides. The submitter never approves their own request.

approvers.roleHint: Takes the position holders at the nearest unit, going up from the KPI's unit.
approvers.relativeHint: Based on the KPI's unit: starts just above the unit the submitter heads and skips units without a head.
